name: confirmation
title: Confirmation
description: A yes or no question asked before something runs, such as an agent's tool call. Built on the Banner: its neutral fill, grid and actions, with Deny and Approve giving way to the answer in the same slot.
docs: Docs & live demo: https://www.fluidfunctionalism.com/docs/banner. Craft notes, the color, layout and motion decisions to keep when you change it: https://github.com/mickadesign/fluid-functionalism/blob/main/skills/fluid-functionalism/references/craft.md#banner.
